text: Gentlemen. A flooded shaft. The robot swims up, puts a block under itself, and stands on it. The old one held crouch and jump, and sank.
Another team built that two weeks ago, and never handed it in. We found it in a box in the back room. Rebuilt it, tested it, shipped it.
Under water, it now prices the way out, dig or swim, and starts in time. And it keeps one water bucket. Just the one.
Same save. Before: blown up by a creeper. Then, on one heart, a zombie. After: a skeleton, two spiders, and it walks away.
Nine courses out of nine. Fifteen minutes on its own, no deaths. The drowning never came back in either build, so we are not claiming that one.
Version zero point nine five point six three. Out now. If that box was yours, thank you.
